newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya bought 300,000 tonnes feed barley - trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya bought 300,000 tonnes feed barley - trade.

text.p: Libya purchased 300,000 tonnes of feed barley during past weeks, traders in Tripoli confirmed on Thursday.
"Yes, Libya purchased 300,000 tonnes recently, it was during the last weeks," one trader told Reuters.
He would not specify the shipment dates nor the price.
European grain exporters on Wednesday said they were seeking confirmation of market talk that Libya had bought 300,000 tonnes optional-origin feed barley.
Several exporters said Libya might have bought 200,000 tonnes of barley in bulk and 100,000 tonnes in bags but stressed this was to be confirmed.
One exporter cited a selling price of $125 per tonne, fob.
